description: This is an ASP.NET Web Forms code-behind file for the 'Leaderboard' page in an online examination system. It manages user session validation, retrieves user information from a SQL database, and handles navigation between pages.

classes.name: Leaderboard
classes.description: Partial class for the Leaderboard page, handling page load and button click events, managing session and database interactions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; checks user session, retrieves semester info from database, and sets session data accordingly.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Placeholder for Leaderboard button click; currently does nothing.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by clearing session and redirecting to login page.
